# Optional Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable

Put the x64 Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable installer here if you want Inno Setup to include and run it:

```text
vendor/redist/vc_redist.x64.exe
```

Download link:

- Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable: <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist>

The Inno Setup script skips this file when it is missing.
